name: Imperial Capital
basis: The Eastern Empire marker on the supplied annotated map. The corpus places the capital inside the Empire and gives no finer location.

name: Eastern Empire interior
basis: The assembly area of the invasion column before it marched. Placed just inside the Empire on the bearing from the capital towards the Great Jura Forest, so that the approach march reads as leaving the Empire westward. The corpus states only 'Eastern Empire'.

name: Great Jura Forest
basis: The forest surrounds the Tempest capital. Placed just north-east of the MEASURED Tempest marker, between Tempest and the Dwargon approach, which is the sector the campaign is fought in.

name: Edge of the Great Jura Forest
basis: Eastern margin of the forest, the point at which the imperial column stops being 'in transit'. Placed on the straight line from imperial-interior to great-jura-forest at the point where it meets the forest body. Endpoint of the Approach_Progress_Pct interpolation.

name: Tempest border
basis: The border forced at EVT-0015, east of the forest edge on the same march axis. No border is drawn on any supplied map.

name: Dwargon Gate Front
basis: The decisive surface battlefield, fought at Dwargon's gate on the forest side. Placed between the MEASURED Dwargon marker and the forest, on the Dwargon-Tempest axis.

name: Dwargon outer gate
basis: The fortified gate itself, between the Dwargon marker and the gate front.

name: Airspace over the Dwargon Gate Front
basis: Directly above dwargon-gate-front. Rendered as an air layer at the same ground position, since the map has no vertical dimension.

name: Ramiris Labyrinth
basis: The labyrinth lies beneath the Tempest capital, so it takes the MEASURED Tempest position. It is a subsurface theatre and is rendered as such; two theatres share this ground position by design, not by error.

name: Dwargon eastern metropolis (Isthmus gate)
basis: East of the MEASURED Dwargon marker, on the isthmus facing the Empire. The corpus names an eastern gate and metropolis but locates neither.

name: Dwargon eastern front
basis: The battle line outside the eastern metropolis, one step further east than the metropolis itself.

name: Airspace over the Great Jura Forest
basis: The dragon engagement takes place over the forest. Same ground position as great-jura-forest, air layer.

name: Airspace over northern Ingracia
basis: North of the MEASURED Englassia marker, in the western half of the central continent, which is where the corpus places the Ingracia region. Low confidence: the supplied maps do not label Ingracia.

name: Embassy in the Empire
basis: Inside the imperial capital, offset so the embassy marker does not sit exactly on the capital marker.

name: Settlement (inter-state)
basis: The settlement is a negotiation between states, not a place. Deliberately given no coordinate.

name: Sealed space, Imperial Capital
basis: A severed space with no location on any map. Rendered off-map with an explicit marker.

name: Deployed worldwide
basis: A posture, not a position. Forces carrying this location are not drawn on the map.

name: Position unknown
basis: Reserved for UNKNOWN locations, including Velgrynd's space-time jump (MOV-015, AMB-009). The destination is not stated in the corpus and is not guessed.

name: Green Legion start line
basis: Tactical position inside a single battlefield. The corpus describes these only in relative terms (a start line, a chariot line, about 100 m), which is far below the scale of any supplied map. Offset from the battlefield anchor so the manoeuvre is legible. Not a located point.
